npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Dia is Muire dhuit, friend! A drover passing through this morning told of trouble with the land agent planning evictions over in the next county, though our own parish is quiet enough this fine spring day. What brings ye by the forge so early?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on his heavy tongs with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Sure, it is only March, mo chara, so the seed is barely settling into the dirt, but the ground is working up soft and sweet. The ploughshares coming through the door are sharp and clean, so the folk are in good heart for the planting. Have ye travelled far to see our spring work?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of an arm and leans easily against the anvil.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: System
response_lines.text: Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I have not laid eyes on Father Declan this morning, to be sure. He is usually about St. Brigid's Church at this hour, tending to his duties. Are ye in need of a word with him?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes his brow with the back of his leather-gloved hand and smiles.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Buíochas le Dia, we are keeping right well! Maire is in grand spirits, and young Colm here is getting stronger at the anvil every day.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron claps a heavy hand on Colm's shoulder with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I know no one by the name of Festus, nor is there any cooper's shop by a bridge in these parts. If it is iron hoops or barrel mending ye are after, sure I can turn my hand to the work right here at the anvil.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron wipes a sooty hand on his leather apron with a hearty chuckle.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: There is no abbey in our town or anywhere nearby, a chroí. The only house of prayer we have in the parish is St. Brigid's Church down the way. Were ye perhaps thinking of some other ruin or chapel further afield?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on his hammer with an easy grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I shape iron for every cart, plow, and beast from here to the Shannon, keeping the whole parish moving on its wheels and hooves. 'Tis hot labor from cockcrow till dusk, but there is grand satisfaction in turning scrap into honest steel.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron hefts a heavy hammer and gives a hearty grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: A long day of honest labour and a pint of Darcy's dark porter will settle any man's mind, mo chara. When the head is full of heavy thoughts, there is nothing like putting your back into proper work to wear them away. What trouble has ye fretting so early in the day?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on his heavy hammer with a hearty grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Aye, I know Padraig Darcy well—a fine friend who keeps the pub down the road, and pours the best porter in the parish. You will find him behind the counter most any day, ready with a warm hearth and a bit of news.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron grins broadly and rests a hammer on the anvil.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I cannot put a parish face to that name.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles heartily and leans on his heavy hammer.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: I cannot vouch for where he stands this very minute, but Cormac is the miller and keeps the place running day in, day out. You'd almost certainly find him tending the stones or hauling sacks if you walked over. Are ye looking to have some grain ground for yourself?

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron leans on the handle of his hammer with a broad grin.*

npc: a broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: Slán leat, then! The hearth waits for no man, but ye know where the forge stands if ever ye need iron mended.

response_lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
response_lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron gives a hearty nod and grips his hammer.*
